reader.requirement: At --std 85 every report group description entry (Formats 1-3, at every level of a report group: 01 group, 02-48 line entry, 02-49 printable item including a SUM counter) may omit data-name-1, the entry then reading its clauses straight after the level-number; FILLER is not a 1985 report entry name.

edition-consulted.switches: ReservedGatedWord asks whether the head word is reserved at the targeted edition: a word reserved only from 2002 (PRESENT) is the entry's data-name at 85 and a reserved word (COBOL0901) at 2023
Constructs.ReportFiller2002: FILLER as a report group entry name refused (COBOL0900) at 85, legal from 2002

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: the optional name is the same at every edition; FILLER as the name is refused at 85 (2002 addition), and which head words can be the name depends on the edition's reserved words
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf09_06 covers unnamed line entries and printable items under named groups; not an unnamed 01 group (RH, CF FINAL), an unnamed SUM counter, nor the edition arms

reader.notes: The grammar makes dataName optional in reportGroupEntry behind the entryNameHere predicate, which only refuses the name reading for a word the targeted edition reserves when the rest parses as clauses. The rule is permissive, so its refusal half is empty; GR1 (where the name is required) is a separate row.
